methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen current 457 kHz digital avalanche transceivers verified 2026-08-11 directly against manufacturer product pages (mammut.com, backcountryaccess.com, ortovox.com, us.arva-equipment.com, pieps.com, blackdiamondequipment.com) and, where a manufacturer page lacked a field or geo-redirected away from US content, corroborated with official user manuals (ManualsLib) or authorized-dealer pages (Climb On Equipment, Avalanche-Equipment.com) reproducing the same manufacturer spec sheet; two seed entries were adversarially corrected rather than guessed — "Arva Evo5" is sold today only as the redesigned "EVO5+" (the legacy plain-EVO5 product URL now 404s), and "Black Diamond Recon X" does not exist as a current Black Diamond product, so the entry was replaced with Black Diamond's actual current beacon, the BD Guide BT (SKU BD1510010000ALL1), which runs on the same Pieps DSP platform BD has sold since acquiring Pieps; several fields (Barryvox S and BD Guide BT weight, Pieps Pro/Powder BT display type, exact USD pricing for BCA Tracker S, Ortovox 3+, and both Pieps BT models) are left null with an explanatory note in provenance rather than estimated, because the manufacturer pages fetched during verification did not state them or geo-redirected to non-US pricing.
